description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Complete Transfer Case Mounting Kit.
Includes Both the Left & Right Metal Mounting Brackets.
Includes all the Rubber Mounts bolt directly between the Mounting Brackets and the Transfer Case.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Rear Mount
Qty 1 – RH Front Mount
Qty 1 – LH Front Mount
Qty 6 – Lock Washers
Qty 6 – Nuts
Qty 1 – Mounting Bracket, RH
Qty 1 – Mounting Bracket, LH
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
